title: AutoDiff expressions of the analytic connector Jacobians: measure their share, rewrite the costly ones
author: Claude-JG
description: For AutoDiff<12>, SlimVector operator expressions take 3.6-4.4 times one loop (#3487). Measure the share of such expressions in the time of the connectors with analytic Jacobians (#2884); if noticeable, write them as one loop or with MultAdd, bitwise or within rounding; otherwise close with the measurement.
releaseNotes: Measured: the connector forces by automatic differentiation take at most 1.4 % of a run (full Newton, a Jacobian in every iteration) and about 0.1 % with the default modified Newton; writing their vector expressions as loops would save at most about 1 %, so they stay as they are.
